scenes.narration: Di tepi hutan bambu, hiduplah kunang-kunang kecil bernama Nala.
scenes.visual: Dusk. Purple-to-orange sky, setting sun, bamboo swaying. Nala flies in from the left. Title at the top.

scenes.narration: Tapi Nala takut gelap. Tiap malam, ia bersembunyi di balik daun.
scenes.visual: Sky darkens to night, stars appear. Nala peeks out from behind a big leaf, trembling, then hides.

scenes.narration: Suatu malam, angin memadamkan semua lampu desa.
scenes.visual: Village houses at the bottom, windows go dark one by one. Wind streaks, bamboo bends, a cloud covers the moon.

scenes.narration: Seekor anak burung tersesat dan menangis. Nala pun memberanikan diri terbang keluar.
scenes.visual: Near-black. A chick on a branch, a tear falls. Nala leaves the leaf and flies toward it, trembling less as it goes.

scenes.narration: Dan ternyata, tubuhnya bercahaya. Nala tak perlu takut gelap, karena ia sendiri adalah cahaya.
scenes.visual: Nala's glow grows and reveals the forest in colour, the chick smiles, many fireflies join. End card.
